subject: Enterprise access handoff: SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist, service accounts — implementation roadmap
thread_body:
Message 1:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@solarahealth.com>, IT Ops <it@solarahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Enterprise access handoff: SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist, service accounts — implementation roadmap

Hi Elena / Solara team,

Thanks for the kickoff earlier — following up with a concise implementation roadmap so CS and implementation can hand off cleanly to your infra team. Attaching our onboarding checklist and a short set of configuration notes we typically use for SSO/SAML + SCIM + network allowlists and service accounts.

Top-level asks from your side before we schedule the configuration window:
- SAML metadata (IdP) export (.xml) + entityID for your SP/IdP.
- SCIM service account or token with write scope for Users and Groups.
- Authoritative public IP ranges or CIDRs to allow for API and console access.
- Primary technical contact for cutover (name + pager/phone).

High-level timeline (target):
1) Week 0 (this week) — metadata exchange, create service account, confirm allowlist ranges. Owner: Solara IT.
2) Week 1 — staging integration: SSO test users, SCIM sync dry-run, validate attribute mapping. Owner: Redwood eng (Marissa) + Solara IT.
3) Week 2 — cutover window (2 hour maintenance), monitor logs, rollback plan. Owner: both.

Configuration highlights (short):
- SAML: We expect an x509-signed AuthnRequest flow. Our SP entityID: https://api.redwood.ai/saml/metadata. ACS URL: https://api.redwood.ai/saml/acs. Please include NameID format urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress for default mapping.
- SCIM: SCIM v2 endpoints; token should have Users:Write, Groups:Write. Sample header: Authorization: Bearer <token>. We recommend attribute mapping: userName -> email, externalId -> employeeId, active -> active.
- IP allowlist: we'll need both management console and backend API ranges. Minimum: 34.198.0.0/18 (example) — please confirm your side.
- Service accounts: naming convention redwood-solara-sync-{env} (e.g., redwood-solara-sync-prod). Grant minimal privileges.

Attachments: redwood-access-onboarding-checklist.xlsx (checklist + owners), sample SAML metadata examples.

Next steps: Elena, can you send the SAML metadata and the SCIM token owner by tomorrow EOD PST? We'll triage and schedule a 60-minute technical setup on Friday.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Technical Program Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

---

Message 2:
From: IT Ops <it@solarahealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@solarahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 10:05:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Enterprise access handoff: SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist, service accounts — implementation roadmap

Hi Vivek,

Thanks — attaching the SAML metadata (solara-saml-metadata.xml) and the current public IP ranges we publish (solara-ip-range.csv). A few quick notes from our infra team:
- We will provide an API token for SCIM; scope limited to Users:write, Groups:write. Token owner: matthew.oneill@solarahealth.com.
- Our SAML is in HTTP-Redirect binding for AuthnRequest; we can enable POST if you require it.
- IP ranges: internal and egress lists included; please confirm which of these map to the console vs API endpoints.

Questions:
1) For SCIM dry-run, will Redwood use a prefixed attribute to avoid collisions (e.g., externalSource=redwood)?
2) For service accounts, what minimum scopes are required for audit logs export during cutover?

Attaching: solara-saml-metadata.xml, solara-ip-range.csv

Best,
IT Ops

-----Original Message-----
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@solarahealth.com>
Sent: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 09:50:00 -0800
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Matthew O'Neill <matthew.oneill@solarahealth.com>
Subject: Re: Enterprise access handoff

Thanks all — forwarding the metadata and our IPs.

Elena


Message 3:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, IT Ops <it@solarahealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@solarahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 15:30:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Enterprise access handoff: SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist, service accounts — implementation roadmap

Great — thank you for the files, team. A few clarifications and an internal owner assignment so the handoff is clean:

Clarifications (answers inline):
- SCIM dry-run attribute prefix: yes, we'll tag Redwood-created users/groups with externalSource=redwood to avoid collisions.
- Audit logs export: we need read scope on Directory and Audit endpoints during the cutover window; we will not persist long-term unless requested.

Owner assignments and schedule:
- Marissa (Redwood eng): run SCIM dry-run in staging, validate attribute mappings, provide delta report — due Tue 12/8.
- Neha (Redwood CS lead): coordinate test user list with Solara, validate SSO login flows — due Wed 12/9.
- Solara (Matthew / IT Ops): provide the SCIM token and confirm a management console allowlist entry for 52.12.34.56/32 and 52.12.34.0/24 for the cutover window.

Staging test plan (brief):
1) Import 10 test users via SCIM (dry-run, no activation).
2) Verify mapping: email, displayName, employeeId -> externalId.
3) Test SAML login with two users (one admin, one regular).
4) Confirm audit logs show provisioning events.

Drive folder with artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bOnboard (notes, redwood checklist).

If agreed, I'll send the calendar invite for the staging session tomorrow.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Implementation Engineer, Redwood Inference

> On Thu, Dec 3, 2026 at 10:05 AM IT Ops <it@solarahealth.com> wrote:
> > Attaching SAML metadata and IP ranges.


Message 4:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, IT Ops <it@solarahealth.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@solarahealth.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2026 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Enterprise access handoff: SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist, service accounts — implementation roadmap

Appreciate the quick turnaround, everyone. Confirming next concrete items and owners:
- Solara: upload SCIM token to the secure thread in Drive (Matthew).
- Solara: add 52.12.34.56/32 to console allowlist and confirm by Monday 12/7 (IT Ops).
- Marissa: run staging dry-run and send delta report by 12/8 EOD.
- Neha: coordinate the 60-min staging session; target Wed 12/9 10:00 PST.

Rollback plan (two lines):
- If provisioning shows >3% unexpected changes or a mismatch in externalId, we will abort and rollback to the pre-sync snapshot (timestamped).

I'll schedule the staging invite once Marissa confirms availability. If anything changes on Solara's side re: IP ranges or token scopes, flag immediately.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Technical Program Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced above:
- redwood-access-onboarding-checklist.xlsx (owners + task list)
- solara-saml-metadata.xml (attached by IT Ops)
- solara-ip-range.csv (attached by IT Ops)
